messages:
Maya Kim: heads up, ticket CS-12345 from Acme — they signed up via SSO and ended up with two orgs. trial credits landed on the older auto-created org rather than their main workspace.
Maya Kim: customer sees 5,000 trial credits under 'acme-dev-old' but 'acme-team' shows 0. workspace ids: acme-team -> org_0xdef1234, acme-dev-old -> org_0xabc9876.
billing-bot: [auto] Payment/Credit event: trial_credits_granted amount=5000 org=org_0xabc9876 ref=trial-promo onboarding-flow
Josh Patel: can we get written consent before moving anything? need to cc the user and have them approve transfer in the ticket.
Maya Kim: copied consent into CS ticket: "please move the credits to our main workspace (acme-team)." customer-authorized.
Alex Rivera: quick root cause: duplicate orgs from SSO + legacy invite flow. grant service keyed on earliest org_id, so the legacy org grabbed the promo. we can perform an admin transfer.
Alex Rivera: verification query to run:
```sql
SELECT org_id, balance, grant_id, created_at
FROM trial_grants
WHERE customer_email='onboard@acme.com';
```
Josh Patel: ran it — row shows org_0xabc9876 balance=5000 grant_id=trial-2025-07-09 created_at=2025-07-09T14:02:10Z. no entry for org_0xdef1234.
Alex Rivera: remediation plan:
1) internal transfer of 5000 units from org_0xabc9876 -> org_0xdef1234
2) add audit note & link to CS ticket
3) verify the customer sees credits and usage decrements on spend

Internal admin call (admin-only):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/v1/credits/transfer" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${INTERNAL_TOKEN}" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"from_org":"org_0xabc9876","to_org":"org_0xdef1234","units":5000,"reason":"duplicate_workspace_migration","ticket":"CS-12345"}'
```
Liam Chen: tagging finance & compliance so ledger entries are correct and we keep an audit trail.
Josh Patel: confirmed customer consent. executing transfer now — will paste tx id when done.
billing-bot: [audit] credit_transfer_initiated tx=tx_20250709_88ef org_from=org_0xabc9876 org_to=org_0xdef1234 units=5000 user=Josh.P
Josh Patel: transfer complete — tx_id=tx_20250709_88ef status=success. ledger updated at /billing/ledger/tx_20250709_88ef. added note: "migrated trial credits for duplicate orgs per CS-12345".
Maya Kim: customer confirms they now see 5,000 in acme-team and ran a quick generate; usage decremented. :tada:
Alex Rivera: opening a follow-up JIRA for product to add a guard in trial grant flow to avoid granting to stale auto-created orgs when SSO creates a new org.
Liam Chen: thanks — i'll mark CS-12345 resolved once product ticket exists and compliance signs off on audit.
Maya Kim: filing summary into Zendesk and adding an internal note at /docs/cs/duplicate-org-credit-issues.md. closing loop.
